name: BOLSA BAZAAR
summary: Bolsa Bazaar is a highly-rated Asian marketplace in Garland serving as a cultural hub for the Vietnamese and broader Asian community. With a 4.8-star rating and over 500 reviews, this shopping center offers authentic groceries, specialty goods, and traditional products that draw visitors from across the Dallas-Fort Worth area.
demographics: Bolsa Bazaar primarily serves the vibrant Asian-American community in Garland, particularly Vietnamese and other Southeast Asian populations. The trade area attracts middle-income families and multigenerational households seeking authentic Asian groceries, goods, and services. Visitors typically range from young professionals to seniors, with strong weekend traffic from families traveling from across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex seeking specialty products and cultural experiences not readily available elsewhere.
description: Bolsa Bazaar stands as a cultural cornerstone in Garland's Asian community, offering an authentic marketplace experience along South Jupiter Road. This bustling shopping center has earned an impressive 4.8-star rating from over 500 reviews, reflecting its strong reputation as a destination for authentic Asian goods, groceries, and services. The center serves as more than just a shopping venue—it's a gathering place where the Vietnamese and broader Asian communities come together to find specialty ingredients, traditional products, and familiar tastes of home. Operating daily from 10 AM to 8 PM, Bolsa Bazaar provides convenient access to a diverse array of vendors and merchants offering everything from fresh produce and seafood to imported goods and cultural items. The center's enduring popularity and high customer satisfaction demonstrate its vital role in preserving cultural connections while serving the practical shopping needs of Garland's diverse population.
